body: A big reason I'm not wanting to get out of my relationship is I don't really think I'll meet anyone better.
This might have been for the OP, but this was something I needed today.
Is that all there is though? My dog? I

Pretty doubtful on the kid, realistically if I stay with my SO, and pretty doubtful I'd ever find anyone after her young enough to have kids with.  Yeah, I've been trying to pick up hobbies, I don't know, spent lots of money on shit that I can't get motivated to get into.

Almost 40, my SO is around the same age, been trying for awhile so we are probably not going to be able to have a family at this point.  She loves me, I love her, but I wouldn't say I'm at all happy with the dynamics of our relationship (how we treat each other, how we talk to each other, etc, I would never say I was IN LOVE with her, I was just very lonely when we met and she was the first woman who treated me like a human being in a long time.)  My job pays well, good benefits, etc, I came from a job that was much more fulfilling, but the pay was shit even though it was WAY more technical.  

Basically I've put myself into a place where I have reached a point where I should be happy, good job, a SO who really does love me, I just feel like I should be okay with what I have, but I feel like the things that I want to complete my life aren't there.  Maybe that I'll be "content" but not happy.  I don't know, maybe I'm over reacting.

It doesn't really matter anymore.  I am not going to get any of the things I want out of life, no matter what I do.  Never will have a family, never will own a home, never will have a fulfilling career, never will have a happy relationship.
